title: The Server plan has been replaced by the Team plan
description: Why Server purchases are closed, how to update Stirling PDF, and what this means for existing subscriptions.
article:
The Server plan has been replaced by the Team plan

The legacy Server plan is no longer available for new purchases. The Team plan is our current offering for self-hosted deployments.

If you arrived here after selecting the Server plan in Stirling PDF, your installation is showing an older purchase screen. That purchase request has not started a new payment. Update your installation to view and purchase the Team plan.

Update your installation#

If someone else manages your Stirling PDF server, send them this page and ask them to update it. Refreshing your browser alone does not update the server.

If you manage the installation:

  1. Back up your configuration and database, and review the release notes for the version you are installing.
  2. Update using the instructions for your deployment:
    • Docker and Docker Compose
    • Kubernetes
    • Windows, macOS, or Unix
    • For installations still on version 1, read the migration guide before updating.
  3. Reopen Stirling PDF and follow the Team plan purchase instructions.

Review current plans and pricing before purchasing. If the Server plan is still the only paid plan you see after updating, contact support@stirlingpdf.com.

Already paying for Server?#

Closing the Server plan to new purchases does not cancel an existing subscription or automatically switch it to the Team plan. Existing subscriptions continue on their current renewal schedule unless cancelled.

You do not need to buy a second subscription because you reached this page. If you want to move an existing subscription to the Team plan, contact support@stirlingpdf.com before purchasing so we can help you avoid duplicate billing.

If you have already paid but cannot find or activate your license, contact support with the email address used for the purchase.

Unable to update yet?#

Contact support@stirlingpdf.com with your installed version and deployment method. We can help you identify the next step. For Enterprise requirements, contact our team.
